name: ModelVariant132_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant132_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (an anchor that swirls to the opposite slot with orb rings, sparks and a full-screen flash); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the ring points and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns the hit, end or spark state; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-149 and 279 images build it with a 256-line flash. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
